text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock C and Stock B at a gain felt satisfying, but a gain alone is not a reason to sell; I should base trades on each position’s risk, expected return, and portfolio role.","Buying more Stock B and Stock D does not make an earlier purchase right or wrong. I should assess whether each stock deserves investment today, without anchoring on my average cost or trying to avoid realizing a loss.","Prices move randomly, so I should not treat recent account swings or past price changes as signals. I should keep a diversified portfolio and trade deliberately rather than make unnecessary changes."]}
